# Updating managed clusters in a disconnected environment with PolicyGenerator resources and {{ cgu_operator }} {#ztp-topology-aware-lifecycle-manager-pg}

You can use the {{ cgu_operator_first }} to manage the software lifecycle of managed clusters that you have deployed using {{ ztp_first }} and {{ cgu_operator_first }}. {{ cgu_operator }} uses {{ rh_rhacm_first }} PolicyGenerator policies to manage and control changes applied to target clusters.
